advert_text:
ANNEXURE Q

STATISTICS SOUTH AFRICA
Stats SA provides scientific knowledge that enables society to understand complex socio-economic
phenomena. It draws its mandate from the Statistics Act, 1999 (Act No 6 of 1999). Stats SA strives to
excel in the following five competencies: Intellectual capability to lead the scientific work of statistics,
Technological competence for purposes of large-scale processing and for complex computations and
accessibility of information to the public, Logistical competence for deployment of (forward and reverse)
logistics of large-scale field operations and for strategic choices regarding operational efficiency and
cost-effectiveness, Political competence in understanding the political environment without being
political or Politicised (commitment of delivery without fear or favour), Administrative competence: The
ability of bringing it all together.



APPLICATIONS
:
All applications must be submitted online on the following link:
www.statssa.gov.za/recruitment
CLOSING DATE
:
04 December 2026
NOTE
:
Applications must be submitted online and must be completed in full on all
fields including the declaration part. Clear indication of the post and reference
number that is being applied for must be selected. The application must include
only completed and signed new Form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service
Department or on the internet at www.gov.za, and a detailed Curriculum Vitae.
Submission of certified copies of Identity Document, Senior Certificate and the
highest required qualification as well as a driver’s license where necessary are
optional but will only be submitted by shortlisted candidates to HR on or before
the day of the interview date. General information: Females, youth and people
with disabilities are targeted for these positions and are hereby encouraged to
apply. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry
assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and other must be an Integrity
(Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical
exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. All shortlisted
candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and
interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three
(3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess
cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence and
integrity. The shortlisted candidate(s) must be available for interviews at a date
and time determined by Statistics South Africa. One of the minimum entry
requirements for SMS positions is the pre-entry certificate submitted prior to
appointment.
For
more
details
on
the
pre-entry
course
visit:
https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/smspre-entry-programme/.
The
successful candidate(s) will be required to sign an annual performance
agreement, disclose his/her financial interests and be subjected to security
clearance. Applications that do not comply with the requirements will not be
taken into consideration. If you have not received a response from this
Department within three months of the closing date, please consider your
application unsuccessful. Note: Statistics South Africa reserves the right to fill
or not fill the below-mentioned post.

POST 42/230
:
DEPUTY DIRECTOR: METHODOLOGIST REF NO: 33/11/26HO (X3 POSTS)

SALARY
:
R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive remuneration package)
CENTRE
:
Head Office, Pretoria
REQUIREMENTS
:
A Bachelor’s degree (NQF 7) in Statistics / Mathematics / Data Science /
Econometrics / Economics, Training in Project Management, SAS, MS Office
Suite, Post-graduate studies in survey methodology, statistics, mathematics,
data science, econometrics, economics, Training in survey methodology / data
analysis, Minimum of 3 – 4 years’ experience as a methodologist / statistician
/ data analyst / data scientist / econometrician or related in a research institution
or statistical agency, Experience in survey processes e.g. data collection,
analysis, evaluation and interpretation, Experience in supervising a team,
Knowledge of statistical production processes, Statistical analysis skills,
Research skills and Writing skills, A hard worker who is innovative, Able to
identify and solve problems, analytical, Willing to adapt to change, Able to
critically evaluate work methods and content, Able to work independently and
accurately.
DUTIES
:
Monitor and coordinate development sampling frames (i.e. Master Sample and
Statistical Business Register), Monitor and coordinate the maintenance and
updating of sampling frames (i.e. Master Sample and Statistical Business
Register), Monitor the development of methodologies and systems for
weighting, estimation and seasonal adjustment, Monitor the evaluation of
surveys and censuses with respect to the methodological dimensions of the
South African Statistical Quality Assessment Framework (SASQAF), Manage
staff and other resources, Develop and review frameworks.
ENQUIRIES
:
Ms R Katjedi Tel No: (012) 310 4797
